resolutions.rationale: F-018 already directly records principal dancer, but the adjective-side collocation and example targets were attached only to the broad U-001 claim and therefore lacked their direct F-018 binding.
required_changes: Move the adjective principal-dancer targets to a dedicated claim under existing U-003 with direct F-018 support.
implemented_changes: Removed the two principal-dancer targets from C-001 and added dedicated claim C-014 under U-003, binding those targets directly to F-018 without changing the entry, facts, or unions.
